title: Product Map: blueprint badge and by-blueprint grouping
summary: Add a sixth grouping to the Product Map tab: 'By blueprint', with one bucket per applied blueprint plus a Project bucket for the project's own requirements. Every REQ row contributed by an applied blueprint carries a compact blueprint badge in every grouping. The by-blueprint bucket's second level is capability, then the usual REQ->US->AC drill-down.
approach: Extend GROUPINGS with 'blueprint'. Read manifest.blueprints[].contributions[] via scope.contributionsForBlueprint as the source of truth for blueprint attribution; fall back to reqId's kebab-slug prefix only when no contributions record is present. Add renderBlueprintGrouping that emits jump-nav + one <details class=pm-bucket> per applied blueprint plus a Project bucket, each carrying a capability sub-heading before its REQ rows. Add a pm-blueprint-badge span into renderReqWrapper (or a wrapping helper) so every grouping's REQ rows render the badge when attributed. Extend inline script PM_GROUPS to include 'blueprint'; renderProductMapPanel adds a blueprint <section>; view/index.js adds a 'blueprint' partial to pmPartials.
deliverables: src/view/product-map.js: groupByBlueprint, blueprintForReq, renderBlueprintGrouping, badge in renderReqWrapper
src/view/html-page.js: PM_GROUPS extended, blueprint <section>, group label 'Blueprint'
test/view/fixtures/blueprint-applied/: fixture project with one applied blueprint (2 contributed REQs) + 2 project REQs
test/view/fixtures/phase-3-6-static.html: regenerated baseline (blueprint grouping is a whitelisted additive delta)
docs/capability-tags.md, docs/how-it-works.md: short line about the by-blueprint grouping and badge
notes: No schema change. Uses manifest.blueprints[].contributions[] as truth (project-local); id-prefix fallback only when contributions absent. Dogfood tree applies no blueprints, so the by-blueprint tab shows one Project bucket - fixture proves the multi-bucket path.
